title: ARIA Rules Schema
description: Validation schema for a template's rules.json artifact. An array of rule documents, each identified by a unique string 'id'. The per-rule payload is polymorphic and validated at runtime by the rule executor.

id.description: Unique identifier used by the rule executor to look up this document (e.g. 'MANDATORY_DOC_RULES', 'CROSS_DOC_RULES').

isActive.description: When 'False' or false, the executor skips this rule. Defaults to active.
